root_idea.summary: A semantic orientation toward what is hidden, inward, concentrated, or settled in its core.
root_idea.development: The root develops from concealment and inwardness to confidential communication, inner or pure substance, the navel and interior, lunar concealment, joy free from grief, and the settled couch or seat.

senses.definition: To please, gladden, or make happy.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is transitive, with people as those affected by the pleasing action.

senses.definition: To conceal, suppress, or keep something secret.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of a matter, statement, feeling, person, or other object kept hidden; the Quranic evidence also includes concealing a person or reciting something privately or inaudibly.

senses.definition: To disclose or confide something privately to an addressee.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction with إِلَى or a comparable recipient expresses revealing a secret to that person while keeping it from others; the object may be a report, affection, or other confidential matter.

senses.definition: To manifest, publish, or make something known.
senses.usage_conditions: This contrary interpretation is explicitly reported for the Quranic expression concerning concealing or manifesting regret. It is a disputed reading; concealment is also, and generally more strongly, reported for that expression.
The verbal noun may describe keeping a matter hidden or conducting it privately.
With an addressee, إِسْرَار expresses imparting something secretly to that person, while its secrecy is maintained from others.

senses.definition: Made happy, joyful, or glad; happy.
senses.usage_conditions: A passive-participial description of one affected by joy or happiness.

senses.definition: A secret, concealed matter, or hidden content.
senses.usage_conditions: It may denote a secret held in the mind, an undisclosed matter, or something known privately.

senses.definition: Secrecy, privacy, or a private manner of acting or speaking.
senses.usage_conditions: Used adverbially with the sense “secretly” or “privately,” in contrast with open or public conduct; it can also describe a suppressed or low voice.

senses.definition: A private marriage-related approach or union.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic marriage-related construction, the term is interpreted as a discreet declaration or proposal of marriage during a waiting period; authorities also report interpretations involving secret sexual union, including an illicit union. These interpretations preserve the association with what is not publicly declared.

senses.definition: A couch, raised seat, or throne.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form is the broken plural سُرُر and denotes raised seats or couches, including thrones.
The lexical description emphasizes an inward delight or expansion of the heart, potentially without an outward sign.

senses.definition: An inner secret, concealed thought, or hidden intention.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form is the plural سَرَائِر and refers to what is inward and liable to be disclosed or tested.

senses.definition: Ease, prosperity, or freedom from straitened circumstances.
senses.usage_conditions: A favorable condition of life, contrasted with adversity or distress.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rejoice, be joyful, or be happy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive use, distinct from the causative sense “to gladden someone.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To greet someone by offering sweet-smelling plant tips.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized customary greeting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut a child’s navel-string; in the passive, to have the navel-string cut.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical and childbirth usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pierce or thrust someone in the navel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of striking the navel with a spear or similar object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To insert a small piece of wood into a fire-stick or spear-shaft, or to be hollow inside.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of preparing a fire-stick and of a hollow wooden shaft or spear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To suffer a complaint or disorder of the navel area.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person with a navel complaint and of a camel affected by the named disorder سَرَر.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone, or cause someone to take, a concubine-slave.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A doubly transitive construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of water, to reach the navel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the level reached by water on a person or object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak secretly with someone or acquaint him with a secret.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or interpersonal confidential conversation, including speaking into someone’s ear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A conditional sale conducted by a secret sign or concealed hand signal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized commercial idiom involving the simultaneous or non-simultaneous display of signet-rings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attribute something to secrecy or mystery.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized attributional construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take a concubine-slave for oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived Form V usage; the related pronunciation تَسَرَّى is also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reveal one’s secret to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported construction distinct from the concubine-related use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a man of low birth to marry a woman of high birth because of unequal wealth or status.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized social idiom.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak secretly together or exchange secrets.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Mutual confidential conversation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To experience pleasure or delight at a sensation or circumstance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare, explicitly qualified usage, reported for pleasure at scratching, pressing, kneading, or at something disliked by another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become concealed or to conceal oneself or itself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a thing or affair becoming hidden, and of the moon becoming concealed by the sun’s light.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take extraordinary pains to conceal or keep something secret.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive concealment construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reveal one’s secret to me.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A recipient-based construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who rejoices, gladdens, or makes another happy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive or adjectival description of a benevolent, affectionate person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The navel-string or the part of it cut from a newborn child.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Distinct from سُرَّة, the navel itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a sequence of births with the navel-strings cut in a similar manner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized childbirth idiom, including consecutive births without a female among them.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing that is revealed, appears, or is made manifest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A contrary lexical use reported in Classical Arabic.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The heart, mind, inner self, or recesses of the mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended use for a person’s inward self.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Private knowledge of a matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the construction فُلَانٌ سِرُّ هَذَا الأَمْرِ, a person possesses privileged knowledge of the matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The external sexual organ of a man or woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative anatomical usage, including the dual expression for the two pudenda.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative usage derived from secrecy or privacy; not restricted to the Quranic marriage-related construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Origin or the essential quality of lineage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of generous origin or the core quality of a family or lineage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The concealed phase of the moon at the end or beginning of a lunar month.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported for the last night, or in some accounts the first or middle concealed phase, with variation among authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The interior, heart, or middle of a thing, night, or month.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended spatial use for what lies within or at the center.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The marrow of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized sense for its inner substance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pure, choice, best, or excellent part or quality of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the best quality of a thing, condition, race, lineage, or rank.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The low, central, best, or most fertile part of a valley or tract of land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: By extension, the middle of a city or meadow and fertile, good land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A line or crease of the palm, face, or forehead; by extension, a facial beauty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural forms include the lines of the hand and forehead and the beauties of the cheeks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The navel or small hollow at the middle of the belly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The remaining mark or hollow after the navel-string has been cut.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A star in the head of Andromeda, called the navel of Pegasus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized astronomical name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A central perforation in a drinking jar through which a tube is fixed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized object-designation based on the navel-like central hollow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place where water rests at the far end of a trough or tank.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized sense for the central or terminal hollow of a watering place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A painful disease, gall, or sore affecting the breast or navel area of an animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used of camels, and in some reports of horses; authorities differ on the precise anatomical location.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The earth, sand, or covering over a truffle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural and botanical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A secret or private matter, and in another synonymic use the pure or best part of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The entry explicitly relates these uses to corresponding senses of سِرّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dates in an unripe state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical or agricultural sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The upper extremities of plant stems.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical noun distinct from the abstract noun “joy.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bier before the corpse is placed upon it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is associated with an auspicious expectation of joy; once carrying the corpse, other terms are used.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The group of stars called the bier of the daughters of Naʿsh, in the Greater Bear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized astronomical designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dominion, sovereignty, authority, ease, or settled affluence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the seat or throne.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The part where the head rests upon the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative anatomical use; plural forms are also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The best or most productive part of a meadow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized landscape and agricultural usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pureness, excellence, or superiority, especially of condition, lineage, or quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the best condition of life and of superiority over another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The heart, mind, or inner self.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Opposed to the outward or public aspect of a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A broad, level stony or sandy expanse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized geographical equivalence to بَطْحَاء.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Secret, mysterious, or conducted secretly; a person who acts secretly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective and substantive description derived from سِرّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A concubine-slave kept as a possession and for sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The vocalization distinguishes this term from the similarly written term for a free woman in a secret sexual relationship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A free woman with whom a man has sexual intercourse secretly; according to one report, a prostitute.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A term distinguished by vocalization from سُرِّيَّة, the concubine-slave.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intelligent, knowing, skilful, or adept at managing affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used of someone who manages property or cattle through knowledge and artful contrivance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A beloved or special companion and friend.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A social and relational use distinct from the skill-related sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The spun thread that has come forth from a spindle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized textile term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An adventive or stranger residing among people to whom he is not related.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun describing lack of local kinship or origin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cause or occasion of happiness and joy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A thing by which someone is made happy or glad.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The tender, succulent, or fragrant upper or concealed parts of certain plants.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical usage including plant tips, lotus parts, and fragrant sprigs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An instrument for speaking secretly, like a scroll or confidential writing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized object noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having had the navel-string cut.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical passive-participial use distinct from the emotional sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a jar, having a central perforation or navel-like opening.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a jar designed with a drinking tube.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hidden or secret affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression وَقَفْتُ عَلَى مُسْتَسَرِّهِ, it denotes becoming acquainted with someone’s concealed matter.

Secret or concealed matter, including the Quran-attested inner content.

Lines of palm, face, and forehead.

Happy or joyful state is represented by the Quranic passive participle.

cautions: أَسَرَّ has a reported but disputed contrary interpretation meaning “manifest” or “publish” in the expression about regret; the concealment interpretation is also explicitly supported and is generally preferred.

The Quranic marriage-related use of سِرّ in 2:235 has varying classical interpretations, including discreet marriage proposal, private sexual union, and—according to some authorities—illicit intercourse.
The public headwords سَرِير and سَرِيرَة are normalized singular citation forms for Quranic plural forms سُرُر and سَرَائِر.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:srr:40763:g1:main reports contrary meanings for سَرَّهُ but explicitly treats the passage as a likely mistranscription of أَسَرَّهُ; it is retained as an editorial note rather than assigned as an accepted lexical branch.
